svg.aria-label: Mapa mięśni – przód, z podgrupami sterowanymi przez ID
svg.metadata: Gymmin front muscle map with code-addressable subgroups. Pectoralis major: clavicular, sternocostal, abdominal. Deltoid: anterior, lateral, posterior. Biceps brachii: long and short heads. Rectus abdominis: upper, middle, lower UI regions. External oblique: upper and lower visual regions. Quadriceps: rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, vastus medialis; vastus intermedius omitted because it is deep. Correction from source artwork: paths named tibialis_anterior were drawn on the anterior thigh, so they are now quadriceps; paths named quadriceps_femoris were proximomedial thigh regions and are now labelled adductor_group.
